title: Tiered Charge Harmonizer with Causal Attribution for Route/Model/Tenant
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Build a production-grade service that computes per-route / per-model / per-customer cost and latency breakdowns with histogram-aware, causal attribution. This service (Tiered Charge Harmonizer) must reconcile traces, batch events, kernel-level execution metadata, and pricing to produce explainable charge and latency breakdowns suitable for the Console UI, chargeback reports, and SLO alerting.

Scope:
- Inputs: runtime telemetry (per-token timing, batch IDs, kernel tags), trace spans, model metadata (variant, quantization profile), routing logs, pricing ledger.
- Outputs: hourly/daily per-route and per-tenant charge tables, latency histograms (P50/P90/P95/P99/P99.9), tail attribution (which model variant / kernel / batch-size contributed), and a mapping from request-id -> charged-rows for debugging.
- Key features: histogram aggregation (HdrHistogram / t-digest sketches), causal attribution by matching span IDs and batch events, handling partial telemetry (heuristics for missing spans), model-variant reconciliation, cache-hit accounting (prefix/KV cache), and support for both streaming and backfill batch jobs.

Architecture proposal (high level):
1) Ingest: streaming consumer from telemetry topic (Kafka) that normalizes events and emits enriched events into a processing topic.
2) Attribution layer: a streaming processor (Flink/Materialize) builds windows keyed by (route, model_variant, tenant, hour) and maintains quantile sketches and charge counters. Special handling for tail-latency attribution: maintain top-k slow requests per-window using bounded heaps and link to spans.
3) Causal joiner: lightweight join against a trace-span store (JAeger/Tempo) to attribute kernel/batch metadata to request traces asynchronously for late-arriving data.
4) Materialization: write compact per-window aggregates to a columnar timeseries store (ClickHouse / Bigtable) plus a debug store for request-level attribution snapshots (S3 with pointer keys).
5) API layer: read service that powers Console dashboards, charge exports, and the charge explain endpoint.

Trade-offs and decisions to be documented: approximate sketches vs exact histograms (storage and compute), window size (1m vs 1h) affecting latency of charge visibility, strict causal joins vs probabilistic attribution for missing spans. Current recommendation: sketches for >99th-percentile memory efficiency plus bounded top-k exact lists for tail investigation.

Operational requirements:
- SLA: produce hourly aggregates within 15 minutes of window close for hosted customers; realtime streaming view (<5s) best-effort for top-tier tenants.
- Backfill: support historical backfills from raw telemetry up to 90 days.
- Retention: aggregated data retained 2 years, request-level debug snapshots retained 30 days.
- Monitoring: end-to-end latency, watermark lag, sketch error rates, attribution confidence score.

Deliverables:
- Design doc (Confluence) with benchmarks and API contract.
- Streaming job + local integration tests, 1 end-to-end backfill job.
- Console API + feature flag for rollout to internal tenants.

Risks and mitigations:
- Missing spans will reduce causal confidence: mitigate via probabilistic attribution heuristics and a confidence field in outputs.
- Cost of storing per-request debug snapshots: store pointers and lazy hydrate from S3 on-demand.
- High-cardinality routes/models causing state blowup: evict cold keys and use per-tenant throttling + summary rollups.

2026-02-20 Diego Alvarez: POC of streaming sketch aggregation complete. Observed ~3x memory reduction vs naive histograms; tail capture requires bounded heap per key (we're using size=128).

2026-03-05 Diego Alvarez: Integration plan with trace store drafted. We will do asynchronous causal joins and emit attribution entries with a provenance vector (direct-span | heuristic).

2026-03-08 Maya Chen: Benchmarks against 1M requests/min traffic: streaming job holds ~30k active keys in memory with 5% eviction churn. Estimated cost for materialization tier (ClickHouse) ~ $2.4k/mo at current cloud prices for primary metrics. Added to cost forecast.
